refined_descriptions.sql-explainer: Explains what an existing SQL query does, step by step, in plain language, covering SELECT, JOINs, subqueries, CTEs, aggregations, and window functions. Unlike email-triage, which classifies inbound support email by intent, urgency, and language, this skill works only on SQL code, not messages. It does not write, rewrite, execute, optimize, or debug queries; does not design schemas, validate syntax against a live database, or perform data analysis; and does not cover any email triage tasks.
refined_descriptions.pdf-signature-check: Verifies whether a PDF contains digital signatures and validates their cryptographic integrity. Read-only: inspects existing signatures and reports validity without altering the file, unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently removes personal data from PDFs. Supports detection of signed fields, tamper detection of signed content, and validity reporting. Does not redact, remove, or modify PDF content; does not create or apply signatures; does not validate certificate trust chains or check revocation; does not handle password-protected or encrypted PDFs.

refined_descriptions.sql-explainer: Explains what a SQL query does, step by step, in plain language, covering clauses such as SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, subqueries and CTEs. Unlike email-triage, which labels inbound support email by intent, this skill takes SQL text as input and returns an explanation, not a classification. It does not write, optimize, execute, validate, or debug queries, does not design or modify schemas, and does not translate natural language into SQL.
refined_descriptions.pdf-signature-check: Reads a PDF and reports whether it contains digital signatures, checking each signature's validity and detecting whether signed content has been altered. Unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently removes personal data and rewrites the file, this skill is read-only and never modifies the PDF. Does not create, add, or remove signatures; does not redact, edit, or extract document content; does not encrypt, decrypt, or convert file formats.
